name: Open a sub-account for a member
description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console, opens a member's record, submits a request for a new sub-account of the given product type with the given opening deposit, and returns the confirmation details.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: The member the sub-account is opened for.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Product type: Regular Savings, Vacation Club or Holiday Club.

parameters.name: opening_deposit
parameters.description: Opening deposit in dollars. The console enforces a minimum.

parameters.name: nickname
parameters.description: The member's chosen name for the account.

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: Confirmation number shown on the confirmation screen

outputs.name: new_account_number
outputs.description: New sub-account number created for the member

provenance.notes: Synthesised from a single successful discovery run. It records the path that worked and nothing else: business outcomes, recovery rules and failure signals describe what happens when things go otherwise and cannot be observed on a run that went right. They are added at review, which is what the draft state is for. Reviewed by hand: step 11 (Submit the sub-account request) marked irreversible, business outcomes and a recovery rule added, and the capability approved. Re-authentication is deliberately not offered: restarting this flow after its submission has run would open a second account.
